messages:
maria: Heads up — finance wants to push 23.4 tonight during our 10pm-12am PST holdback. Who can press prod if the release signer is unreachable? deploy-bot shows no current owner.
aj: I'm oncall but my MFA device is in transit — might not be able to accept OTP. :grimacing:
sam: Can we do a role-swap? There's a temp-press role but it needs security approval.
ben: Suggest we pin the rollout to 1.2.7 and only canary. If signer is unreachable, block full rollout.
maria: Pin sounds good. Can someone run `./release pin --env prod --version 1.2.7`? I don't have deploy perms.
aj: I can run it if someone grants a short-lived press-role to my account. @security any objections?
david: security: We require MFA for human presses. We can do a jump-start: create a short-lived service token tied to an approval flow (two approvers). Approvers proposed: maria + ben.
maria: Ben and I ok with that. Ben? :+1:
ben: +1
sre-bot: deploy-bot status: OWNER:none, QUEUE:0, LAST_PRESSER: release-bot-2 (1729981110)
deploy-bot: To claim press, run:
```
release-cli claim --role temp-press-2025 --approvers maria,ben --duration 2h
```
aj: Attempting claim now.
aj: Claim failed — "MFA not enrolled" error.
david: Ok workaround: I'll create a short-lived service token and store in 1Password, then create a temporary IAM binding for aj. Token will require two-approver audit. I will NOT post token here.
maria: Please notify once token in 1P and assign to aj.
david: Done. Token created and stored in 1Password as 'presser-temp-aj-173701'. I created IAM binding 'presser-temp-aj' for 2h.
aj: I pinned 1.2.7 and pressed canary at 22:15 PST. Canary started at 10% and is healthy so far.
ben: Watching metrics — latency and error-rate. I've disabled auto-roll to 100% until we sign off.
maria: If we see regression, rollback plan is: `release rollback --to 1.2.6 --reason "regression"`
aj: Noted. I also updated the release notes: https://internal.company/releases/1.2.7 (hotfix summary + rollback instructions)
david: After the window I'll rotate/revoke the token and remove the temporary IAM binding. Audit log will include approver signatures.
maria: Thanks everyone. I'll add this thread to ticket RL-4823 and mark the holdback as covered.
ben: :ok_hand:
